prompt: Original tiny fantasy companion for Soulmonsters: one small soft rounded wedge-shaped living kite-paper creature with no separate torso or legs. Indigo body, two broad warm ivory forehead folds over a short coral muzzle and little ivory chin. Two tiny blunt side fins act as stabilizers. Small friendly amber almond eyes, a curious little mouth, one tiny golden temple knot. The face is its actual living anatomy, not a helmet or mask. One short gold cord grows from the back edge and ends in ONE ivory-and-indigo chevron paper tab. Slightly tilted balancing pose, simple tender character, just a few broad flexible shapes and quiet color areas. Clean 2D manga cel illustration with crisp dark outlines, flat colors and one shadow. One complete creature on white with generous margins. No armor, props, weapons, text, scenery, many wrinkles, gradients or textures.
review: Um único corpo-rosto, sem tronco ou pernas; duas pequenas abas estabilizadoras e uma aba na rabiola. O terminal saiu como etiqueta fechada com estampa chevron, não recorte chevron, mantendo família por padrão. Olhos são mais abertos e maiores que os da jovem para ternura; não presumir que isso atende ao gosto final do autor. Mantém índigo/marfim/coral e nó de têmpora.

prompt:
Create ONE original Soulmonsters creature concept in clean authorial 2D manga cel style. Own attached family art supplies identity and color, not a size template. Preserve the INDIGO/IVORY wedge-shaped living face, small CORAL muzzle, AMBER eyes, one small gold temple knot and chevron soul-tail lineage, but rebuild proportions for the requested early stage. This is a living creature with taut kite-paper structures as anatomy, not a human wearing armor or a miniature knight. Large clear color regions, confident dark contours, ONE hard cel-shadow, few broad continuous forms, no crumpled origami tessellation, gradients, realistic rendering, texture noise or tiny ornamental facets. Fullbody hero threequarter on WHITE, all parts and tail visible with generous margins, no text, scenery or extra characters. Living creature and kite construction equally important, with subtle selective stepped contour accents. No weapons, armor suit, sword, chest crystal or ragged cape in early forms.
CHILD redesign, provisional name Tramino, an expressive original biped reptile-kite companion. About THREE heads tall, compact pear torso, short neck, two short creature arms with THREE fingers/ivory claw tips each and two bent sturdy legs with THREE broad toes. Shape should be lively and approachable, not a muscular human torso or slim robot. Face is a smaller softer version of the own selected wedge family: TWO low broad ivory asymmetrical forehead planes against indigo cheeks, short coral muzzle, ivory chin and one GOLD temple knot. No biological helmet, no covered mouth visor: face is living anatomy. Eyes SMALL warm amber almond shapes in narrow indigo sockets, alert mischievous focus, NOT huge oval glistening child eyes and not an evil angry squint. Gentle confident small closed grin with ONE tiny ivory tooth at mouth corner. No long orange crocodile muzzle. Forehead side points short and blunt, not crown of tall horns.
Body indigo chest/forearms/ankles, coral upper arms/outer thighs/hips, ivory belly as ONE smooth unbroken volume with ONE oblique tension seam and tiny gold flank knot. One forearm has a small taut crescent indigo membrane and thin golden edge, other forearm plain, subtle beginning of later asymmetry; keep both hands clear. ONE tiny folded indigo back-keel, not wings or worn cape. Short thick tail supports balance then transitions into a continuous gold soul-cord ending in TWO ivory/indigo chevron tabs, root and both tips visible. Curious forward step, one hand extended invitingly toward player, other at side, all four limbs readable. The potential for the larger young form is visible without adult pauldrons, armor plates, cape, sword, crystal or closed knight visor. Strong clean approachable living-kite silhouette with restrained details.
review: Dois braços, duas pernas, três dedos visíveis em cada mão e três dedos nos pés. Rabiola com duas abas, raiz legível. Rosto em cunha mais brando que o jovem, olhos pequenos abertos e um dente discreto. A raiz da vela e antebraço distante precisam de perfil para model sheet. A silhueta corporal é próxima da jovem por continuidade, mas menor e menos muscular; grau de diferenciação está em avaliação.
